title: SISO Task / Idea / Gap (global /task convention)
description: Per-task durable shared brain. Any agent or human may create one. Superset of the SISO org .tasks convention (oracle-streaming/.tasks) — adds parent_task_id/root_task_id (lineage), fundamentals/locations_of_truth/context_pointers (stop re-derivation), and learnings (carry-forward). All new fields optional, so existing TASK-NNNN tasks validate unchanged.

id.description: Unique ID, format: TASK-NNNN (zero-padded). Subtasks use dotted suffix: TASK-0042.1

status.description: Lifecycle stage. New ideas/gaps start as 'backlog'.

domain.description: Which part of the project this belongs to.

target_agent.description: Which agent/lane owns this. Empty string until claimed. Set atomically by `task claim`.

created_by.description: 'human' (Shaan) or the agent name that logged it.

evidence.description: file:line proof or the source audit that backs this. Reconcile against the project's proven ledger before flagging a gap.

verified.description: Has a second pass confirmed this is real (not a false alarm)? Unverified items are candidates, not facts.

execution_log.description: Append-only timeline. Each entry: {timestamp, action, by, notes}. NEVER rewrite — only append. This is the running journal of done/tested/learned.

parent_task_id.description: LINEAGE. Explicit pointer to the task this descends from (beads/temporal pattern). A new task inherits its parent's learnings into fundamentals. Empty if root.

root_task_id.description: LINEAGE. Top of the tree this task belongs to. Walkable from any node. Equals id if this is a root.

fundamentals.description: Invariants / norms / constraints that DON'T change run-to-run. The first thing a cold agent reads so it stops re-deriving context. Seeded from parent's learnings on init.

locations_of_truth.description: The single most underrated section. Where the real state lives for this task.

path.description: file path, url, db table, or endpoint

context_pointers.description: Cheap re-entry hooks: file:line anchors, grep terms, prior task ids, doc paths. What to load to get back into this task fast.

learnings.description: Distilled, promotable findings (not raw log). Carry-forward fuel for child tasks. Promoted to spine `memories` (distilled=1) by the brain bridge.

source_task_ids.description: provenance: which tasks produced this learning (cass pattern)
